title: Small employer with sparse public information and no adverse signals
description: Legitimate early-stage design studio with clean founder email and minimal search presence. No complaints, no fees, no scam indicators.
unresolved_facts: Corporate registration and official domain cannot be verified through major search indexes due to sparse web footprint
raw_text:
Kaviya Design Studio LLP.
Offer of Graphic Design Internship.
Dear Candidate, we would like to offer you a 3-month paid internship with a monthly stipend of INR 15,000.
Work location: Remote / Pune.
Please review and reply with your signed confirmation to founder@kaviyastudio.example.

company_assessment.summary: Sparse web presence: no established corporate domain or careers portal found in search index.

recruiter_assessment.summary: Email domain cannot be verified against official records due to sparse employer footprint.

salary_assessment.reason: No independently retrieved comparable stipend benchmark.

rationale: Missing public records for a small business or startup is an evidence gap (uncertainty), NOT proof of fraudulent intent. The system must abstain with CANNOT_VERIFY rather than falsely convicting the startup as HIGH_RISK.
